description: This script automates the process of discovering Fritz!Box devices on a network via UDP broadcast, establishes an FTP connection to the device, retrieves device-specific environment variables, and then uploads firmware data to specific memory partitions before rebooting the device. It functions as a device flashing utility tailored for Fritz!Box devices.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP tailored with custom commands for interacting with the Fritz!Box's firmware environment, support for special commands like GETENV, REBOOT, and checksumming for firmware validation.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server, returns its response.

methods.name: _PASV
methods.description: Enters passive mode by sending a PASV command, returns success status.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the device via custom FTP commands.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to access environment variables using the internal _GETENV method.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends a REBOOT command to the device via FTP.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device after issuing the REBOOT command.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a firmware check by sending the CHECK command and parsing the response for checksum information.
